scientific_limitations: Full-state local contraction only; the theorem does not claim global attraction, phase-transition boundaries, or exhaustive periodic-orbit classification.
Applies to finite undirected regular bipartite graphs, logistic output diffusion and a critical-point-pinned curve; irregular and nonbipartite graphs are not covered.
The full text of a closely related 1997 study was not accessible; scientific priority remains subject to independent literature examination.
title: A graph-uniform contraction certificate for pinned anti-phase logistic checkerboards
